dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt system (JMA standard receipt software), compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux; uses INDEXED files with DYNAMIC/SEQUENTIAL access, COPY with REPLACING using // delimiters
evidence: SELECT ... ASSIGN RECE01PARA ORGANIZATION IS INDEXED

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA inpatient receipt (Nyuin receipt) claim data editing and compilation — processes receipt files RECE62/64/65/66 to build claim line items for Japanese medical insurance billing
purpose.summary: ORCR0690 is a batch program in the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that edits and compiles inpatient (Nyuin) claim detail rows. It reads multiple indexed receipt data files (RECE62, RECE64, RECE65, RECE66), applies various business rules (point/count editing, special receipt item editing, bundling checks), and writes output claim lines and error records for Japanese health insurance receipt submission.

notable_features: INDEXED files with DYNAMIC and SEQUENTIAL access modes
COPY with REPLACING using // delimiter syntax
Large working-storage tables (OCCURS 100) for special receipt item editing
Extensive Japanese-language comments (Shift-JIS/EUC encoded, rendered as latin-1 mojibake)
266 PERFORM statements indicating structured procedural decomposition
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
verdict.notes: Source comments are in Japanese encoded as EUC-JP or Shift-JIS but decoded as latin-1, producing mojibake. File is 4470 lines and clearly production-grade JMA ORCA software. Truncated at 16000 chars but enough structure is visible to classify confidently. The // REPLACING delimiter is characteristic of GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL rather than IBM mainframe COBOL.
